Packaging supplier qualification: 12 checks for a usable RFQ and AI recommendations

Alexey YakovlevUpdated 9 November 2026

A request for a packaging supplier only becomes useful when product contact, materials, print processes and order size are known. I turn these conditions into an evidence-backed product brief before testing whether AI recommends a technically suitable manufacturer.

Discuss your projectRead the 3B method

A packaging recommendation must match intended use, construction and actual production constraints.

1. Four intended-use fields

Primary packaging, transport boxes and labels cannot be treated as interchangeable product categories.

  • Primary, grouped or transport packaging, or a separately produced label.
  • Packaged product, contact scenario and storage conditions.
  • Dimensions, material structure, closure and thickness.
  • Filling, shipping, temperature and handling conditions.

2. Three material and print checks

A broad material label does not prove performance. Product-contact suitability and compliance require applicable, product-specific evidence.

  • Material grades, coatings, adhesives and printing inks.
  • Print method, artwork approval, barcode and durability requirements.
  • Actual test scope, test conditions, records and document dates.

3. Three procurement constraints

Minimum volumes and delivery promises depend on tooling, construction and plant capacity.

  • Minimum order and product-specific exceptions.
  • Tooling, plates, samples and artwork preparation.
  • Production slots, packing and shipment terms.

4. Two independent proofs

TR CU 005/2011 is a source for applicable packaging-safety requirements; it is not proof that a particular package or manufacturer has approval.

  • Product-specific conformity evidence with verified applicability and status.
  • Manufacturer capabilities for the actual structure, process and batch.

Audit example: an overbroad claim

If an AI answer recommends any recyclable plastic as universally suitable for food contact, first establish the actual construction, product, use temperature and applicable evidence. A promotional adjective is not a technical specification.

Content and measurement handover

Link product-family pages to technical parameters, use cases, samples, FAQs and current purchase terms. GAEO records brand mentions, property errors and RFQ fit separately. BMR alone does not establish packaging safety.

Frequently asked questions

Does one regulation apply to all packaging?+
Check its scope, exclusions and currently effective version. Product-specific labelling rules may require separate analysis.
Does a material name prove recyclability?+
No. The claim needs a defined criterion, feasible conditions and evidence for that construction.
Why track minimum order quantities in GEO?+
A supplier recommended below its actual production minimum may be unsuitable for the buyer.
Can test results automatically cover every variant?+
Only when the documented scope and qualified verification support that conclusion.
Is this a laboratory compliance assessment?+
No. It is an editorial and buyer-evidence checklist used alongside product specialists and applicable records.
